name: Resilient
body:
Aura faint transmutation; CL 4th; Weight —; Price +2,000 gp

DESCRIPTION

Resilient armor and shields slowly repair themselves over time. They regain lost hit points at a rate of 2 hit points per hour (or 1 hit point if the equipment has the broken condition). In addition, once per day when a resilient suit of armor or shield would be reduced to 0 hit points and destroyed (or destroyed outright by effects like disintegrate), it is instead reduced to only 1 hit point and left with the broken condition.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor; Spells mending, tempering; Cost +1,000 gp
